---
title: "SHANK3 ASO RBP Evidence Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- if (file.exists("_config.yml")) getwd() else if (file.exists("../_config.yml")) normalizePath("..") else getwd()
clip <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/04_rbp_clip_overlap.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
motif <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/04_rbp_motif_overlap.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
expr <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/04_rbp_expression.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
func <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/04_rbp_function.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ranked <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/06_ranked_rbps.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Evidence policy

CLIP peaks are **never invented**. Unreachable databases yield empty/partial tables with `status` / `warning` columns. Motif and expression layers may use clearly labeled curated priors.

# CLIP overlaps

```{r}
knitr::kable(clip)
```

# Motif overlaps

```{r}
knitr::kable(head(motif, 50))
```

# Expression (neuron / NPC)

```{r}
knitr::kable(head(expr, 40))
```

# Function annotation

```{r}
knitr::kable(head(func, 40))
```

# Ranked RBPs

```{r}
knitr::kable(ranked %>% dplyr::filter(in_top_report))
```
